t1_layerdiffuse_sdxl_attn_fullscene.verdict: real per-pixel RGBA produced end-to-end, but alpha does NOT separate background: 99.66% of pixels are near-opaque (alpha>200); background renders as opaque white, not transparent. Transparency generation effectively failed for this config.

t1_layerdiffuse_sdxl_attn_turtle_single.verdict: Single-object retest per coordinator ask: alpha does NOT track the subject either. Worse than full-scene: zero transparent pixels at all (min alpha 145, mean 254.86). Confirms the SDXL Attention-Injection LayerDiffuse path is unreliable on this ComfyUI core (0.25.0) regardless of prompt composition.

t2_birefnet_hr_image14.verdict: All sure_foreground and sure_background guard probes pass (correct subject coverage, no leaks on core probes). But straight-RGBA reconstruction and 3 of the edge-hygiene probes fail: BiRefNet-HR leaves a bright/paper-colored halo on soft translucent watercolor edges (fish fin, pink fringe, pale seaweed). This matches prior project finding (wiki: 'White-key beats birefnet (flat art)') that flat watercolor art on pure white needs scripts/white_key.py (flood-fill) rather than ML matting for edge-clean results. BiRefNet-HR is a legitimate general-purpose baseline but is NOT gate-clean on this asset class out of the box.
